The plate looks like a side plate of about 20-22 cm. On it are three pieces: two cheese pizza slices and one garlic bread or cheese toast slice.

Each pizza slice is about 15 cm long. A thin-crust slice of that size would weigh roughly 80-100 g, so the two slices together come to about 180 g.

The garlic bread piece is about 10 x 12 cm, which puts it at roughly 60 g.

That gives a total of about 240 g. At about 2.7 kcal/g, the energy comes to roughly 650 kcal.
